rule: schematic_parity net_conflict ("Pad missing net given by schematic")
decision: DOCUMENTED, no electrical difference. Pad 5 (CT, delay-capacitor pin) of the TPS3890 supervisors U5-U8 is a no-connect in the schematic (KiCad names it unconnected-(Ux-CT-Pad5)) and carries no net on the board. Both sides leave CT open; no copper connects to it. The parity checker only differs on the auto-generated name of the no-connect net.
evidence: kicad-cli pcb drc --schematic-parity (4 parity items, all listed); pcbnew pad net dump; kicad-cli sch erc -> 0 violations
owner_check: If a non-minimum supervisor delay was intended, CT needs a capacitor; that would be a schematic change, not a parity fix.
identity_rule: Covers only these four (reference, pad) pairs at this board sha256.
